entities.name: PDU SESSION INACTIVE
entities.description: State of a PDU session when it is inactive in the UE.

entities.name: Collision of procedures

entities.name: Ignore PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION RESULT
entities.description: UE behavior to ignore the received message and continue with ongoing procedure.

relations.description: Condition of invalid PDU session identity triggers sending 5GSM STATUS message.
5GSM STATUS message contains 5GSM cause IE set to #43.
5GSM cause IE is set to #43 due to invalid PDU session identity condition.
PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION RESULT message processing requires checking PDU session state.
Collision condition leads to UE ignoring the PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION RESULT message.
Ignoring the message is a step in continuing the UE-requested PDU session release procedure.
Collision condition involves receiving PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION RESULT during another procedure.
Collision condition occurs during UE-requested PDU session release procedure.
